# City Phones Saudi Arabia

City Phones is an ecommerce store serving Saudi Arabia with smartphones, electronics, accessories, offers and installment options.

- Website: https://cityphonesa.com
- Sitemap: https://cityphonesa.com/sitemap.xml
- Languages: Arabic (primary), English
- Contact and policies: available from the website footer.
